observations: dnn_processing includes ONNX Runtime and OpenVINO build backends
ONNX backend accepts 4-D NCHW FLOAT models and single input
ONNX backend runs synchronously and a single inference request is effective
device=cuda selects ONNX Runtime CUDA EP but failure warns and falls back to CPU upstream
stable n9.0.1 dnn_processing pixel formats do not include AV_PIX_FMT_CUDA
development trunk contains AV_PIX_FMT_CUDA support guarded by CUDA and zero-copy capability checks
libvmaf and libvmaf_cuda exist; CUDA variant only accepts CUDA frames
CUDA/NVENC/NVDEC support is hardware dependent and must use a capability matrix
ONNX Runtime CPU/CUDA, OpenVINO, TensorRT/TensorRT-RTX, NCNN Vulkan and MIGraphX runtime families are exposed
built-in model wrappers include RealESRGAN and RIFE families among others
backend choice is implementation capability, not an FA3 routing authority
